title: 把字句 — do something to an object
explanation: 把 (bǎ) moves the object before the verb to stress what happens TO it. The verb needs an extra element after it (result, location, 了…).

examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng 。
examples.en: Please close the door.

examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le 。
examples.en: I finished the homework.

examples.pinyin: tā bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng 。
examples.en: He put the book on the table.

examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ míng zi xiě zài zhè lǐ 。
examples.en: Please write your name here.

title: 被 — passive
explanation: 被 (bèi) marks the passive: the subject receives the action. The doer can be left out.

examples.zh: 我的自行车被人借走了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi rén jiè zǒu le 。
examples.en: My bike was borrowed by someone.

examples.pinyin: dàn gāo bèi dì di chī le 。
examples.en: The cake was eaten by my brother.

examples.pinyin: bēi zi bèi dǎ huài le 。
examples.en: The cup was broken.

examples.pinyin: tā bèi lǎo shī jiào qù le 。
examples.en: He was called away by the teacher.

title: 比 — comparison
explanation: A 比 (bǐ) B + adjective says A is more … than B. Use 更/还 for 'even more'. A 跟 B 一样 = A is the same as B.
syllabus_ref: 句型·比较句2：A 比 B + 更/还 + 形容词；A 跟 B 一样

examples.pinyin: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng 。
examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.

examples.pinyin: tā bǐ wǒ gāo 。
examples.en: He is taller than me.

examples.pinyin: gāo tiě bǐ qì chē kuài de duō 。
examples.en: The high-speed train is much faster than a car.

examples.pinyin: wǒ de shǒu jī gēn nǐ de yí yàng 。
examples.en: My phone is the same as yours.

title: 如果…就… — if…then
explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) states a condition; 就 (jiù) introduces the result. 如果 can be dropped in casual speech.

examples.pinyin: rú guǒ xià yǔ ， wǒ jiù bù qù le 。
examples.en: If it rains, I won't go.

examples.zh: 如果你有时间，就来我家。
examples.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shí jiān ， jiù lái wǒ jiā 。
examples.en: If you have time, come to my place.

examples.pinyin: rú guǒ bù dǒng ， jiù wèn lǎo shī 。
examples.en: If you don't understand, ask the teacher.

examples.pinyin: rú guǒ pián yi ， wǒ jiù mǎi 。
examples.en: If it's cheap, I'll buy it.

title: 不但…而且… — not only…but also
explanation: 不但 (búdàn) … 而且 (érqiě) … adds a stronger point: 'not only A, but also B'.
syllabus_ref: 复句·递进复句：不但……，而且……

examples.zh: 她不但聪明，而且很努力。
examples.pinyin: tā bú dàn cōng míng ， ér qiě hěn nǔ lì 。
examples.en: She is not only clever but also hardworking.

examples.zh: 这里不但方便，而且便宜。
examples.pinyin: zhè lǐ bú dàn fāng biàn ， ér qiě pián yi 。
examples.en: Here is not only convenient but also cheap.

examples.zh: 他不但会说汉语，而且写得很好。
examples.pinyin: tā bú dàn huì shuō Hàn yǔ ， ér qiě xiě de hěn hǎo 。
examples.en: He not only speaks Chinese but also writes it well.

examples.zh: 这个菜不但好吃，而且健康。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge cài bú dàn hǎo chī ， ér qiě jiàn kāng 。
examples.en: This dish is not only tasty but also healthy.

title: 除了…还/也… — besides
pattern: 除了 + A（以外），还/也 + B
explanation: 除了 (chúle) … 还/也 … means 'besides A, also B'. With 都 it means 'except A, all …'.
syllabus_ref: 固定格式：除了……（以外），……还/也/都……

examples.pinyin: chú le Hàn yǔ ， wǒ hái xué shù xué 。
examples.en: Besides Chinese, I also study math.

examples.zh: 除了跑步，他也喜欢游泳。
examples.pinyin: chú le pǎo bù ， tā yě xǐ huan yóu yǒng 。
examples.en: Besides running, he also likes swimming.

examples.zh: 除了周末，我每天都上班。
examples.pinyin: chú le zhōu mò ， wǒ měi tiān dōu shàng bān 。
examples.en: Except weekends, I work every day.

examples.pinyin: chú le tā ， dà jiā dōu lái le 。
examples.en: Except for him, everyone came.

title: 先…然后… — first…then
explanation: 先 (xiān) … 然后 (ránhòu) … puts actions in order: first do A, then do B. 再 can replace 然后.
syllabus_ref: 复句·承接复句：先……，再/然后……

examples.pinyin: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo ， rán hòu shuì jiào 。
examples.en: I shower first, then sleep.

examples.pinyin: xiān zuò zuò yè ， rán hòu kàn diàn shì 。
examples.en: Do homework first, then watch TV.

examples.zh: 我们先吃饭，然后去公园。
examples.pinyin: wǒ men xiān chī fàn ， rán hòu qù gōng yuán 。
examples.en: We eat first, then go to the park.

examples.pinyin: xiān xiǎng qīng chu ， zài jué dìng 。
examples.en: Think it over first, then decide.

title: V 得/不 + 补语 — can / cannot (potential)
explanation: Insert 得 (de) for 'able to' or 不 (bu) for 'unable to' between a verb and its result: 看得懂 = can understand (by reading), 看不懂 = cannot.
syllabus_ref: 补语·可能补语1：动词 + 得/不 + 动词/形容词

examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn de dǒng 。
examples.en: I can understand this book.

examples.pinyin: dōng xi tài duō ， wǒ ná bù le 。
examples.en: There are too many things; I can't carry them.

examples.zh: 老师说的话你听得懂吗？
examples.pinyin: lǎo shī shuō de huà nǐ tīng de dǒng ma ？
examples.en: Can you understand what the teacher says?

examples.pinyin: jīn tiān de zuò yè zuò de wán 。
examples.en: Today's homework can be finished.
